_comment: Map character key -> ElevenLabs voice_id (pick via ElevenLabs UI). Underscore keys are config, not roles.
_note_vtag: Per-line tone override: put vtag on a say-command in the script (e.g. vtag:'[whispers]'); it prefixes the TTS text only, not the displayed line. Otherwise generate_voice.py uses TAG_PREFIX[who].
